reasoning: 驗證目標：未選取任何交通／天氣頻道時按下 Traffic & Weather 鍵，彈出視窗告知尚未設定並提供選取城市的選項；選擇後顯示 Browse-Traffic & Weather 類別並可選取頻道。為什麼這樣切：條款是一條鏈——空狀態的提示、提示上的選項、選項導向的畫面、該畫面上的可選取性；ER 逐段對應。空狀態為前置條件的關鍵，故明列「未設定」。[A-SX03]。與 157 的差別：該 leaf 是已設定情形下按鍵的行為（§8.2.1）。

tcs.tc_title: Traffic and Weather with nothing set offers to select a city
tcs.test_item: If no traffic/weather channels were selected and the Traffic & Weather button is activated, the HU shall display a pop up to indicate that no traffic/weather channels are set for the Jump feature and provide an option to select a city, and if the user chooses to select a city the HU shall display the Browse-Traffic & Weather category and allow selection of a traffic/weather channel
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. No traffic/weather channel is set for the Jump feature
5. At least one city with traffic and weather data is available
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Activate the Traffic & Weather button and read the HU screen
2. Choose the option to select a city and read the HU screen
3. Select a traffic/weather channel from the displayed category
4. Read the channel held for the Jump function
tcs.expected_result:
1. A pop up is displayed indicating that no traffic/weather channels are set for the Jump feature, and an option to select a city is offered
2. The Browse-Traffic & Weather category is displayed
3. The selection is accepted
4. The selected traffic/weather channel is held for the Jump function
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
